parsed.rationale: Four separate `extension` declarations on `String` are spread across three distinct packages (`Playlist`, `AnalyticsMacros`, `Analytics`) with no restraint markers on any record. The cluster signal is `name-collisions:String`, indicating the same extended type is being augmented in multiple places. Where the extensions share utility (e.g., string manipulation helpers used by both `Playlist` and `Analytics`), they should be consolidated into a single dedicated file — ideally within the `Playlist` package's existing `String+HTMLDecoding.swift` or a new shared `String+Extensions.swift` in a common dependency — to avoid name-collision risk and improve discoverability. Extensions that are genuinely package-local (e.g., the macro plugin helper in `AnalyticsMacros`) may remain in place if they have no cross-package consumers.
